newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-BIGGEST EVER BET ON ENGLAND-WALES GAME.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-BIGGEST EVER BET ON ENGLAND-WALES GAME.

text.p: An anonymous English woman has waged a record 78,000 pounds ($125,200) on England to beat Wales in a rugby union Five Nations match on Saturday, bookmakers William Hill said on Friday.
The bet laid at 1-3 will pay 104,000 pounds if England wins. William Hill cut the odds to 2-7 after the bet was laid. Wales are quoted at 5-2 and a draw at 16-1.
The woman from Essex, near London, staked 18,000 pounds on England beating Scotland in their opening fixture, winning 3,000 pounds.
She placed a then-record 46,000 pounds for a rugby union game on England to beat Ireland, winning 15,000 pounds.
She did not bet on the England-France game when France came back from 6-20 down to beat England 23-20. ($1=.6228 Pound)
